proj.title: What I've been up to on GitHub
feat.lede: I passed the iPAS AI Application Planner exam, then built a platform to help other people pass the same one. Official past papers and community question banks, scattered everywhere, turned into one clean quiz system that works offline and syncs across devices — one codebase, three certifications.
feat.n1.t: The hard part isn't collecting questions — it's being trusted
feat.n1.d: Official past papers and community-sourced questions live in strictly separate buckets and never mix, and every question shows its source. That's what makes "official past papers only" a real option rather than a claim.
feat.n2.t: Zero dependencies isn't purity — it's so you can study on the train
feat.n2.d: A vanilla JS SPA plus a service worker. No framework, no bundler. Add it to your home screen and it behaves like an app; answer questions with no signal and your progress syncs when you're back.
